## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Website Modernization & Organic SEO
- Complete redesign of legacy business websites into high-speed, modern web platforms (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS).
- Core Web Vitals optimization (sub-1 second load times, 99+ mobile performance score).
- Organic SEO architecture to rank top on Google across US local markets (e.g., California, Los Angeles) and Latin America.
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) designed to convert visitors into booked calls and sales.

### 2. Google Business Review Shield & Reputation Funnel
- Automated post-service review collection via email, SMS, and WhatsApp.
- **Smart Review Gating**:
  - Reviews rated 4 or 5 stars are automatically redirected to public Google Business Profile and Apple Maps, rapidly increasing positive ratings and organic Google Maps visibility.
  - Reviews rated under 4 stars (1 to 3 stars) are kept private and routed directly to management as customer service tickets, protecting public reputation while allowing the business to resolve issues privately.

### 3. Custom ERP & Enterprise Cloud Systems
- Bespoke ERPs for operations, inventory management (Kardex WAC), purchasing, and executive analytics.
- IFRS / NIIF accounting compliance with real-time financial reporting (ContAme: https://contame.amephia.com/).
- Native electronic invoicing integration with SRI Ecuador (Facturón: https://facturon.ec/).

### 4. Native Electronic Invoicing (Facturón SRI)
- Emits all 6 official SRI documents (facturas, retenciones, notas de crédito/débito, liquidaciones, guías de remisión).
- XAdES-BES digital signature via .p12 certificate, instant authorization in under 2 seconds.
- REST API with multi-tenant company keys, client portal, and mobile apps.

### 5. Education & Academic Management (AmePhia EDU)
- 100% compliant with Ecuador MinEduc 2025 (Table 9) and LOEI regulations.
- Automated bank reconciliation with 7 national banks, native LMS, and PWA parent portal.

### 6. Data Privacy & LOPDP Compliance (ShieldData)
- Built for Ecuador's Organic Personal Data Protection Law (LOPDP) and ISO 27001 / NIST cybersecurity.
- AI-generated RAT records, automated ARCO rights portal, and SPDP inspection dossiers.

### 7. Nearshore Software Engineering for US Companies
- Senior full-stack engineers with zero intermediaries.
- 100% client source code ownership upon milestone completion.
- Contracts under State of California law or international jurisdiction.
